articles.title: China is about to launch an ambitious moon mission to hunt for ice in one of the solar system’s coldest places - NBC News
articles.description: China is poised to launch Chang’e-7, its most technologically complex lunar mission to date, ​in  search of frozen water near the moon’s south pole.
